text:
```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  rebuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run documentation collection
      run: |
        python collect_documentation.py

    - name: Create parameters
      run: |
        python create_parameters.py

    - name: Implement variables
      run: |
        python implement_variables.py

    - name: Write tests
      run: |
        python write_tests.py

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Push changes
      run: |
        git add .
        git commit -m "Rebuild model site"
        git push origin main
```
